Bug_Title: "super.finalize()" should be called at the end of "Object.finalize()" implementations
Bug_Explanation: The finalize method is overridden incorrectly. The call to 'super.finalize()' is made before 'releaseSomeResources()', which means any cleanup code in the parent class might not be executed after releasing resources in this class. The call to 'super.finalize()' should be at the end of the method to ensure proper resource management.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method which indirectly relies on the finalize method. The finalize method incorrectly calls super.finalize() before releasing resources, which violates the proper cleanup order. The test fails intentionally to highlight the bug.
